main.LicenseType: chart-types, chart-districts, chart-expiry, chart-disc-rate, chart-contact, kpi:total, kpi:contractors, insight:types, insight:disc_rate — split into role (קבלן/עובד אחראי/סוקר/מפקח) and material (צמנט/פריך); unknown types flow through
main.LicenseNumber: skip: per-licence identifier — kept off the page by policy
main.Name: chart-crew, insight:sole, insight:multi, insight:employers — used only for matching (holders with several licences, contractors who are also their own responsible worker, employer↔contractor); individuals are not listed
main.Phone: chart-contact — completeness share only, values never shown
main.AdditionalTelephone: chart-contact — completeness share only, values never shown
main.Fax: chart-contact — completeness share only, values never shown
main.Email: chart-contact — completeness share only, values never shown
main.Address: chart-contact — completeness share only; street addresses never shown (settlement/district come from their own columns)
main.District: chart-districts, insight:district, insight:friable_geo — blank shown as לא צוין and disclosed
main.LicenseExpirationDate: chart-expiry, kpi:expiring, insight:expiry — register lists only valid licences, so the earliest expiry is the nearest one; no wall clock
main.DisciplinaryAspects: chart-disc-rate, chart-disc-years, chart-susp, kpi:disc, insight:disc_rate, insight:disc_trend, insight:suspension, insight:unparsed — parsed into dated events (deduped across a holder's rows); aggregate only, nobody named
main.EmployerContractor: chart-employers, chart-crew, insight:employers — employers are businesses (incl. sole traders) and are named
